description: This file defines the 'jjwg_Maps' class, an extension of the base 'jjwg_Maps_sugar' class in a SuiteCRM module. It manages configuration settings, geocoding interactions with Google Maps API, address formatting, and address geocoding related CRUD operations. It also includes methods for handling related module addresses and meetings, as well as administrative configuration management.

classes.name: jjwg_Maps
classes.description: A SuiteCRM module class that handles geocoding, address management, and module configuration for map visualizations and geolocation within the SuiteCRM environment.

methods.name: configuration
methods.description: Loads configuration settings from the Administration module and applies defaults where necessary.

methods.name: saveConfiguration
methods.description: Saves updated configuration settings from user input into the Administration module.

methods.name: updateGeocodeInfo
methods.description: Updates geocode info for a bean, including address, latitude, longitude, and status.

methods.name: updateRelatedMeetingsGeocodeInfo
methods.description: Updates geocode info for all meetings related to the specified bean.

methods.name: updateMeetingGeocodeInfo
methods.description: Updates geocode info for a specific meeting bean after save, using parent relationship data.

methods.name: updateGeocodeInfoByAssocQuery
methods.description: Updates or inserts geocode info into a custom related table based on association queries.

methods.name: updateGeocodeInfoByBeanQuery
methods.description: Updates or inserts geocode info directly into the bean's primary table via SQL queries.

methods.name: deleteAllGeocodeInfoByBeanQuery
methods.description: Removes all geocode information from the custom geocode table for a bean.

methods.name: getGeocodeAddressesResult
methods.description: Retrieves database result set of addresses needing geocoding, limited by specified parameters.

methods.name: getGoogleMapsGeocode
methods.description: Makes a request to Google Maps API to get geocode data for an address, optionally returning full response.

methods.name: defineMapsAddress
methods.description: Determines the address details for a module record based on its object type and related addresses.

methods.name: defineMapsFormattedAddress
methods.description: Constructs a formatted address string based on address components and type.

methods.name: is_valid_lng
methods.description: Checks if a longitude value is valid (-180 to 180).

methods.name: is_valid_lat
methods.description: Checks if a latitude value is valid (-90 to 90).

methods.name: logGeocodeInfo
methods.description: Logs relevant geocoding information for debugging purposes.
